reviews.title: Subscription Trap
reviews.text: As many other people have stated before, the built in difficulty to unsubscribe is a trap. It’s the easiest thing in the world to add an unsubscribe feature in the app. But they don’t. They know it’s an issue and they made it that way by design. Instead, they have you go to the website to send a feedback email, which will then respond and send you another link to fill out a form (within a certain period of a time so if you take too long they can make you start over again and prolong the subscription period). It’s a Russian nesting doll of steps aimed at wearing down the resolve of people who want to cancel. Thankfully I didn’t think deleting my account was enough, and went through the shenanigans.
